review:
A 20-line Aztec game with a moody soundtrack of drums and chanting. The jaguar is the star: whenever it lands, it turns three random symbols into multiplier wilds – or bumps up the multiplier if it hits a wild that's already there.

Three scatters give 12 free spins where every wild sticks, so the jaguar's wilds pile up through the round. That makes even base-game spins less predictable than a normal line slot. High volatility, 10,000x max and a 97.02% RTP.
pros: Excellent 97.02% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
